meta.title: Phygi Ads — Traditional advertising, finally measurable
meta.description: Your ad printed on everyday items, with a QR code. Every scan is counted and you follow results live.

hero.title: Traditional advertising,
hero.description: In Africa, physical advertising takes most of the marketing budget, yet nobody measures its results. Phygi Ads changes that.

how.title: Your printed ad,
how.description: Your campaign is printed on everyday items: bread bags, pharmacy bags, flyers, pizza boxes, grocery bags. Every scan is counted and you follow results live.

steps.title: We print your ad
steps.description: You pick your formats, districts and budget. Every item carries your artwork and a unique QR code.

steps.title: People scan
steps.description: Customers leave with your ad in hand and scan the code for an offer, a coupon or a payment.

steps.title: You measure
steps.description: Scans, conversions and peak hours come in real time, format by format.
